create_OpikLogger: create an OpikLogger instance to log LLM events to an Opik server with project name, API key, and workspace
build_opik_payload: build trace and span payloads from LLM kwargs and response objects for Opik logging
test_async_log_success_event: test the async_log_success_event method that queues LLM success events for asynchronous flushing to Opik
review_log_success_event: review the log_success_event method that logs LLM success events synchronously to Opik via native client or HTTP
summarize_async_send_batch: summarize the async_send_batch method that splits queued events into traces and spans and submits them to Opik
